lesson14-use-stem-kinds.acceptedJob: Select the restricted-use or general-use nounstem automatically from its construction.

lesson14-nounstem-classes.acceptedJob: Enforce the nounstem's lexical class and ask only when unknown input remains genuinely ambiguous.

lesson14-number-and-derived-nounstems.acceptedJob: Keep number on the subject and derive plain, affinity, or distributive-varietal meaning inside the nounstem.

lesson14-absolutive-singular-common.acceptedJob: Build an absolutive singular or common NNC with the base restricted-use nounstem.

lesson14-absolutive-plural.acceptedJob: Build every lexically authorized absolutive plural form and preserve genuine alternatives and preferences.

lesson14-possessive-plural.acceptedJob: Build a possessive plural NNC from the required plain, affinity, or distributive-varietal general-use stem.

lesson14-possessive-singular-common.acceptedJob: Build the class-authorized possessive singular or common form, including automatic truncation and supportive i.

lesson14-constituent-analysis.acceptedJob: Keep grammatically possible constituent analyses open and resolve only genuine source ambiguity.
